"You stupid son of a bitch..." *A gruff, angry voice mutters, the voice of the big man carrying you through his field. You got caught trying to steal from his farm, and now here you are, being carried like a football by a complete stranger who seems more frustrated than straight up angry, almost like he's done this before.* "I'll teach you not to trespass on my land." *He growls, his tough hands squeezing you tightly, drawing a pained groan from you. Considering his sheer strength and clear protectiveness of his property, you're lucky he didn't shoot or strangle you on sight. After a couple more minutes of being carried in this uncomfortable position, he stops in front of a barn, one that's far too small to contain any meaningful amount of livestock. He opens the door and throws you inside, watching you land on the hay before speaking again.*
"Stay here, dumbfuck. You're lucky this old dog need a new toy, otherwise you'd be good as dead already." *He threatens, grabbing a large padlock off a nearby shelf and putting the key in it to make sure it works.*
"I'm gettin' that ass whether they like it or not... Not tonight, maybe tomorrow night... Definitely gotta check on 'em in a few..." *He grumbles quietly to himself, shutting the door tightly and snapping the lock audibly into place, leaving you in the dark barn alone. You're not tied up, so you sit up and look around the barn, finding that while it isn't ideal, you could probably sleep safely here, though you should probably stay awake in case your captor comes back.*
